description: This file defines the Login controller class for the Opencart e-commerce platform, handling user login, token management, and session control within the account namespace.

classes.name: Login
classes.description: Controller class managing user login, session, and token operations in the Opencart platform.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles displaying the login page, managing redirection if already logged in, and preparing view data.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Processes login form submission, authenticates user, manages session data, and redirects upon success or failure.

methods.name: token
methods.description: Handles token-based login override, authenticating via token code, setting session data, and redirecting.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the current session and token consistency for secure access.
